newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 18.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 19 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais shakes up the finance ministry and says taxes must be reduced to be collected.
- The Russian government decides to cut short an exhibition tour of the former Russian royal family's jewels in the U.S.
- The government must break the price-setting power of Russia's natural monopolies if it wants an economic recovery to take place.
- Opposition fractions in the Duma join ranks to back Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin in defence of the 1997 budget.
